prompt: Build a modular Enterprise Document Management System in C# structured into: (1) File Upload Gateway handling multi-part MIME streams and virus scanning hooks, (2) Full-Text Indexing Engine tokenizing text and maintaining inverted index search structures, and (3) Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Subsystem enforcing granular file permission policies.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Gateway Score: 0-5 (Evaluates stream handling and chunked upload safety)
Module 2 Indexer Score: 0-5 (Evaluates text tokenization and inverted index lookup)
Module 3 Rbac Score: 0-5 (Evaluates permission evaluation and security enforcement)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates end-to-end document storage and retrieval flow)
